description: This file is a Perl script for managing OpenWRT package metadata, generating configuration files, dependency lists, JSON manifests, and CycloneDX SBOMs. It includes functions for version comparison, dependency resolution, and package category handling, indicating its role as a build and packaging utility script.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string (e.g., '1.2.3') into a numeric representation for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on a comparison version and operators like lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates kernel configuration overrides based on package metadata and build system config.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively checks dependencies of a package to determine if a specific package dependency exists.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper function to find dependencies without risking infinite recursion.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines dependency relationship between two packages based on their 'depends' attributes.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency conditions and relations for package configuration.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict conditions between packages.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Outputs package configuration options grouped into categories and menus.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Outputs package override configurations.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Generates comprehensive package configuration including categories, dependencies, and defaults.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical AND condition string into Kconfig syntax.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Converts a complex logical condition string into a combined Kconfig expression.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Wraps dependencies in conditional statements based on build configuration conditions.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates Makefile dependencies and build rules for packages based on metadata.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs package source file information.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary variables such as repository info and package dependencies.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Outputs license information for packages, optionally including license files.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on a patch version.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs user and group assignments for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_manifest_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON array of package metadata suitable for external tools or reports.

methods.name: image_manifest_packages
methods.description: Reads an image manifest file to extract package names and their versions.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Creates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON document from a list of components.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM for image packages based on their manifest and package metadata.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM for package manifests.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses and executes command-line options to invoke appropriate functions for package management tasks.
